messages:
Noah (Events): 15 min till show. Last-minute run-of-show tweak: Q&A first, then a short roadmap. AV — can you confirm recording + captions?
Asha (Eng): Doing a warm encoder test. OBS crashed once with the NDI plugin on the rehearsal; switching to the software NDI fallback. If it repeats we'll drop HDMI feed and use USB-C camera.
Ben (Audio): Hearing intermittent pop on the left channel from the FOH return. Repatching now to the spare DI and testing levels.
Noah (Events): If the camera switch or audio repatch runs >90s we should call a 2-min warm buffer. Who will pin a caption-lag note?
Zoe (Comms): I'll pin: "Captions may be delayed ~15-25s. Recording will be posted after the event."
caption-bot: Captions provider status: degraded (transcription latency increased). Local fallback AiCaption v0.9 available at http://local.caption/serve — recommend enabling if latency >20s.
Asha (Eng): Enabling AiCaption local fallback and starting NDI software fallback. Also reduced encoder to 720p/30 to reduce CPU.
Ben (Audio): DI swap done, pops gone, levels look stable. :thumbsup:
Maya (Product): Jules, confirm Q&A first OK? We can run 10m condensed roadmap after and push demo deep-dives to follow-up threads.
Jules (CEO): Q&A first sounds great. For any deep technical asks, tag engineering owners and we'll schedule follow-ups. Prioritize a clean recording.
Noah (Events): Backup capture plan: Zoe local recorder + cloud ingest with retries. Asha, can you enable ingest reconnect policy to 10 tries?
Asha (Eng): Set reconnect tries to 10 and enabled local recorder health checks. Also taking a snapshot of encoder config to /tmp/encoder-snapshot.log.
Zoe (Comms): Local recorder live. I'll upload raw within 1h after event.
Noah (Events): Caption-bot shows local AiCaption active, expect ~10s latency now. Pinning live transcript link in chat. Warm count T-4.
Ben (Audio): Quick note — if we do any camera swap, remind presenters about mic placement; lavs are sensitive when switching belts.
Maya (Product): Follow-ups: 1) compile unanswered Qs + owners 2) upload demo clips and notes 3) post transcript with timestamps.
Jules (CEO): Thanks team. Start on time if stable, pause if recording quality suffers. Noah, you have final call.
Noah (Events): Spot checks green: encoder fallback stable, audio fixed, captions local. Starting warm count T-2.
